description:
Places to eat and drink: by name, kind, cuisine, map area or nearness, open now, with
a menu, serving lunch today.

ApiLang.description:
The language dish names, descriptions and section titles come in: the menus' own
German, or English as bissl translated them.

oneOf.description: The most useful places first: with a menu, prices, photos, open now.
Nearest to `lat`, `lon` first - the order whenever they are given, unless another.

bbox.description:
Keep to a map area: "west,south,east,north" in degrees - a town, a district, the
streets around a place. Everywhere when left out.

cuisine.description: Only at places of this cuisine, as OpenStreetMap names it: "italian", "vietnamese".

has_menu.description: Only places whose menu with prices bissl read.

kind.description:
Its kind as OpenStreetMap tags it: restaurant, fast_food, cafe, bar, pub,
biergarten, ice_cream, food_court, bakery or pastry.

lang.description:
The language of dish names, descriptions and section titles: de, the menus' own, or
en, as bissl translated them.

lat.description:
The latitude of a point - the user's, or one they name - to measure distances from
and sort nearest first; with `lon`.

limit.description: Places to answer with: 1 to 30, 10 when left out.

lon.description: The longitude of that point; with `lat`.

lunch_today.description: Only places serving a lunch menu today.

offset.description: Places to skip, for the next ones: 0 when left out.

q.description: Words to search for among the places: part of a name - "figlm" finds Figlmüller.

name: search_venues

Place.description: A place to eat or drink, the same in every answer.

address.description: Street, house number, postcode and town; null when bissl has none.

area.description:
Its district or town, to say where it is: "7. Neubau", "Mödling"; null outside every
town bissl knows. No filter takes it.

cuisines.description: Its cuisines as OpenStreetMap names them: austrian, italian, pizza, vietnamese...

distance_m.description: Metres from the point asked about (`lat`, `lon`), when one was given.

kind.description:
Its kind as OpenStreetMap tags it: restaurant, fast_food, cafe, bar, pub,
biergarten, ice_cream, food_court, bakery or pastry.

open_now.description: Open right now by its opening hours (Vienna's time); null when bissl can't read them.

price_level.description: "€" to "€€€€" from its menu's prices; null while bissl doesn't know.

slug.description: bissl's name for the place: what `/v1/venues/{slug}` and `get_venue` take.

url.description: Its page on bissl, with every menu: link to it.

PlaceListing.description: A place in the list of places.

has_menu.description: bissl read a menu with prices from its website.

lunch_today.description: It serves a lunch menu today.

cuisine.description: The cuisine kept to, when one was asked for.

note.description: Why there is nothing, when there is a reason to say.

total_places.description: Places matching, of which `places` holds `limit` from `offset` on.

title: Search places
